Meta Platforms Experience Widespread Outage, Users Report Issues

Users of Meta's Facebook and Instagram platforms reported experiencing major outages, with thousands of users unable to access their accounts. The issue appears to be a widespread system problem rather than regional glitches. Reports of the outage surfaced on various platforms, including Downdetector, indicating that it was not limited to specific regions or countries.
